prompt_text: Who is the best real estate agent in Pleasanton CA to sell my house?
answer_verbatim:
There’s no single objectively “best” agent for every seller — the right agent for you depends on your goals (highest price vs fastest sale), your home type and price range, and your personal preferences. I can help you find the best-fit agent in Pleasanton — but first a few quick questions so I can narrow the search:

- What is your property address or ZIP code (or at least neighborhood)?
- What is your timeline for selling?
- Is maximizing sale price the top priority, or do you want speed, low fees, or a hands-off selling process?
- Roughly what price range is the home in?
- Any special features (luxury upgrades, lot size, multi-unit, condo, tenant-occupied)?

If you’d like to proceed now, I can:
- Pull together a short list of top-performing Pleasanton agents (based on recent local sales, list-to-sale ratios, and reviews).
- Provide a comparative summary of each agent’s recent comparable sales, typical commission, and marketing plan.
- Draft an interview script and a short set of questions you can use when you meet agents.

If you prefer to vet agents yourself, here’s a quick checklist and suggested interview questions to help identify the best candidate:

How to pick the right agent
- Look for recent comparable sales (same neighborhood, similar size/condition) and high list-to-sale-price ratios.
- Check days-on-market for their listings — short DOM can indicate good demand/marketing.
- Read reviews on Zillow, Realtor.com, Google and Nextdoor; ask for references from 2–3 recent sellers.
- Prefer agents who provide a tailored marketing plan (professional photos, floor plans, targeted online ads, broker network).
- Confirm MLS exposure, open house strategy, and whether they use staging/home prep specialists.
- Compare net proceeds (sample seller net sheet) after commissions and typical closing costs.

Interview questions to ask each agent
1. How many homes have you sold in Pleasanton in the last 12 months? Can you show three recent comparable listings you closed?
2. What was your average sale price vs list price in those transactions?
3. What is your marketing plan for my property (photos, video, social ads, email blasts, broker tour)?
4. How do you price and stage homes like mine? Do you provide a pre-listing home inspection or staging advice?
5. How will you communicate progress and how often?
6. What’s your proposed listing price range and your recommended list price — and how did you arrive at it?
7. What is your commission rate and are you willing to negotiate based on services?
8. Can I see references from recent sellers in my neighborhood?
9. How long is your listing agreement? Any exit options if I’m unhappy?
10. What problems have you encountered selling homes like mine and how did you solve them?

If you want, give me the address or neighborhood and your priorities and I’ll shortlist 3–5 well-matched Pleasanton agents and draft an email you can send to set up interviews. Which would you prefer?
